comparison: The notifications plan's F1 (storage, the writer and the scan) against the baseline F0 recorded; inbox-refresh against its S3 form, recorded at F1. Used once: just perf --budgets (tools/perf_check.py, tools/perf-compare.py). Changes are fractions of the baseline's count.

import-flush.why: the analysis trigger that keeps the import ledger (the bench fails one file in five, each a ledger row written)

inbox-refresh.closed.why: must fall by 90% or more: the ledger's cheap state on the partial index instead of the counts

inbox-refresh.open.why: the counts read while the inbox is shown are linear in the live rows (a count is a scan of the partial index; the bench's ledgers are all new, so both the total and the new are full ranges): only the closed refresh is the cheap state

pending-thumbs.why: the pass's ATTACH parses the catalog's schema, which versions 8 and 9 grew by their tables, indexes and triggers: a fixed cost per pass, not per file
